purpose: Verify deterministic cyclic timing and bus supervision while the controller is enabled but no motion command is active.
preconditions: Controller starts from a cleared fault log.
Axis is configured with nominal position and velocity limits.
For hardware runs, fieldbus link is online and drive torque remains inhibited until the enable step is commanded.

bench_extension.operator_action: Record selected NIC/CAN device, drive model, bus topology, and a photo or screenshot of the online fieldbus state.

operator_notes: Use this as the first profile after power-up because it exercises timing and supervision without requesting motion.
Do not use this run as a hardware validation claim unless the bench-extension evidence is attached.
